hunks.lead: Information categories we use (see '[What Information do we collect?](https://privacycenter.instagram.com/policy/?section_id=1-WhatInformationDoWe)' for more detail on each information category). The actual information we use depends on your factual circumstances, but could include any of the following:
lines: *   [Public content](https://privacycenter.instagram.com/policy/?subpage=3.subpage.3-PublicContentWhatContent) you or others create or share, like posts, comments or audio on Meta Products
*   Interactions with AI at Meta and related metadata. For example, information you or others exchange with AI at Meta like content and messages
